messages:
Auditor Jess: Hi team — can you provide a playback/decryption proof for artifacts encrypted with KMS key projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/llm/cryptoKeys/decrypt-key between 2025-11-01T00:00Z and 2025-11-03T00:00Z? Auditor wants evidence that service account redwood-llm-decryptor only used decrypt after MFA change. Need logs + sampled payloads and chain-of-custody.
Alex P: Thanks, Jess. We'll need to pull KMS CryptoKeyDecrypted audit logs + IAM policy change history for that SA. Can you confirm timezone and whether you need raw payloads or redacted?
Auditor Jess: UTC is fine. Prefer redacted payloads with identifiers replaced, but full logs for key usage ok.
Mira S: I'll run a Logs export (Cloud Logging) and a service log correlation. Query I'll use: 
```
resource.type="kms_key_ring"
protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.AsymmetricDecrypt"
protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail="redwood-llm-decryptor@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
timestamp >= "2025-11-01T00:00:00Z" AND timestamp < "2025-11-03T00:00:00Z"
```
Alex P: Also need IAM audit for role binding changes. Example filter: 
```
logName="projects/redwood-prod/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity"
protoPayload.methodName:("SetIamPolicy" OR "ModifyRole" OR "BindServiceAccount")
resource.labels.serviceAccount="redwood-llm-decryptor@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
```
Samir: Oncall can we run the playback script in the recorded testenv? Runbook path: /runbooks/evidence_playback.md step 3b. I'll coordinate the maintenance window if needed.
opsbot: Ticket ENGSEC-4821 created (evidence-playback). Assigned to @Mira S, @Alex P. ETA 48h.
Mira S: One gotcha — we rotated ephemeral key material on 2025-10-31T22:00:00Z; include the specific keyVersion in exports. I'll add keyVersion to the manifest.
Alex P: For chain-of-custody we'll produce manifest.csv with columns: artifact_id, key_name, key_version, service_account, timestamp, export_hash. We'll sign it with ops GPG and include signature.asc.
Auditor Jess: That works. Also please include any vulnerability triage notes if you see abnormal decrypt frequency or failed decrypts.
Samir: Noted. We'll add triage.md if anomalies surface and link to incident ticket.
Mira S: Quick heads-up: some payloads include PII — we'll redact using deterministic masking (sha256 prefix). Example transformation command: `jq '.payload |= (. | @base64 | sha256d) | .payload = (.[0:12])'` — we'll include mapping keys in a sealed envelope per auditor request.
Alex P: Plan: Mira exports logs -> redact -> upload to S3 presigned URL (7-day TTL) -> attach manifest + signed hash -> share via secure transfer. Oncall runbook will produce playback.log (transcribed stdout) saved alongside exports.
Auditor Jess: Please cc compliance@auditor-firm on the share and confirm you've captured both KMS key access (Cloud KMS audit) and application-level decrypt calls (service logs) — we need both correlated.
Mira S: Confirmed — export includes Cloud KMS audit logs and application service logs correlated by request_id and trace.
Samir: I can run a quick correlation join: request_id -> log_entry.requestMetadata.requestId then join on request_id to KMS logs. Will include the SQL/snippet used for the join.
Alex P: If we hit any retention/privilege blockers, we'll escalate to security@redwood-inference and open an emergency evidence access PR.
opsbot: Reminder: evidence export will spawn CLM task ENGSEC-4821-EX and place artifacts in s3://redwood-evidence-staging/ENGSEC-4821/. Lifecycle and access ACLs applied.
Mira S: Export started — progress ~12%. ETA ~90m. I'll post presigned links and manifest when ready.
Auditor Jess: Great, thanks. If anything needs approval for sharing, ping me and I'll route it.
Alex P: Scheduling a 30m call to walk through queries and the redaction approach — will invite @Auditor Jess and compliance.
Auditor Jess: Onboard. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Mira S: Upload complete. Presigned link posted to secure channel (shared with compliance@auditor-firm). Manifest hash: sha256:abcd1234... Signed by ops GPG.
Samir: No anomalous decrypt spikes in timeframe — decrypt rate is within baseline. I included a short triage note (triage.md) with a couple of minor app errors unrelated to key usage.
Auditor Jess: Received links and manifest. We'll review and follow up with any clarifying Qs. Appreciate the quick turn.
Alex P: Thanks team — closing loop here. If auditors request replay logs, we have preserved playback.log and the runbook invocation details.
opsbot: ENGSEC-4821 moved to status: evidence-shared.
